open_points.subject: M03 Room lifecycle and pre-import correction
open_points.text: The import renames no room: it stores a picked project's rooms under the names the v1 instance gave them (A16), and a room is never renamed or removed afterwards (R0-10). So the owner, before making the export on the VPS (R0-72), corrects there every room name of the projects to be picked that breaks this rule (owner, 2026-11-23, State 0 round-59 T1).
open_points.question: Is correcting a legacy room name before export an explicit exception to the rule that a Room is never renamed, and what owner action performs that correction on the VPS?
options: Allow a one-time pre-export rename of an existing legacy Room through a specified migration action
Treat the correction as an out-of-band mutation of the legacy store and state that R0-10 does not govern that source-side preparation
Keep Room names immutable and exclude every project containing a nonconforming room name from the import
open_points.default_guess: Define a one-time owner-run source-side migration action that may rename rooms before export and explicitly exempt it from R0-10.

witness.initial: A picked VPS project has an existing room named "bathroom for the wheelchair".
events: The owner checks the room name before export as R0-96 requires.
The owner prepares the project for the one permitted import.
outcomes: R0-96 requires the owner to change the existing room's name before export.
R0-10 and M03 require the existing room never to be renamed, so its name remains unchanged and the project cannot be imported as instructed.
witness.observer: The owner preparing the migration, and later the agent reading the imported room name

open_points.subject: M03 Room creation by import
open_points.text: Registry's own record, written by the owner or by Kernel for the agent.
open_points.question: Who creates the production Room record when the import stores a picked project's existing rooms: the import itself, the owner, or Kernel?
options: The confirmed import creates each production Room record from the imported room
The owner creates each room separately before or after importing the project
Kernel creates each imported room on behalf of an agent
open_points.default_guess: The confirmed import creates the production Room record while preserving its imported identity and name.

open_points.subject: M03 imported Room added instant
open_points.text: written once: the instant it was added and the request id of its create, as the caller gave it (R0-36; owner, 2026-10-31, State 2 A01), absent for a room the import brought in.
open_points.question: What value does an imported Room carry as its written-once added instant, and is the final phrase declaring only its request id absent or both the request id and added instant absent?
options: Preserve the room's original added instant from the VPS export
Record the successful import instant as the room's added instant
Let an imported Room have no added instant and no create request id
open_points.default_guess: Preserve the original added instant when the source supplies it; otherwise make the added instant absent and state that imported Rooms are the exception.
